item.title: CVE-2026-122321 (critical 9.1): Kyverno 1.18.0 before 1.19.2 contains a signature verification bypass in verifyImages because cached verification
item.description: Kyverno 1.18.0 before 1.19.2 contains a signature verification bypass in verifyImages because cached verification results are keyed by the image reference string (such as a tag) rather than bound to the verified digest, so cache hits skip signature and attestation checks. An attacker who can submit workloads and move a registry tag can warm the cache with a signed image, repoint the tag, and have Kyverno admit the workload and use mutateDigest to pin the unverified digest.

item.description: Kyverno from 1.17.0 before 1.19.2 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows namespace-scoped tenants to modify resources in other namespaces through NamespacedMutatingPolicy targetMatchConstraints.expression CEL output lacking namespace checks. item.description: A flaw was found in the SAML HTTP-Redirect binding implementation of Keycloak.
